description: Answers equity-compensation planning questions by calling the OptionsAhoy calculators: incentive stock option and alternative minimum tax (AMT) exercise timing, non-qualified stock options, restricted stock unit sell-versus-hold, qualified small business stock (QSBS), single-stock concentration, protective-put hedging, and funding a cash goal from equity. The financial math is deterministic and verifiable (https://optionsahoy.com/verification); OptionsAhoy's API is keyless.
name: OptionsAhoy Equity Planner

skills.description: Optimize a multi-year incentive stock option (ISO) exercise schedule under the alternative minimum tax (AMT).
examples: When and how many of my 20,000 incentive stock options should I exercise over 4 years to minimize alternative minimum tax?
skills.name: ISO exercise and AMT optimizer

skills.description: Compute the tax and after-tax proceeds of exercising non-qualified stock options (NSOs) and holding versus selling.
examples: How much tax will I owe if I exercise 5,000 non-qualified stock options, and should I sell at exercise or hold?
skills.name: NSO exercise tax

skills.description: Compare selling vested restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest against holding them, on an after-tax, risk-adjusted basis.
examples: My restricted stock units just vested. Should I sell now or hold for long-term capital gains?
skills.name: RSU sell-versus-hold

skills.description: Analyze a concentrated single-stock position and the after-tax cost of diversifying it.
examples: Eighty percent of my net worth is in one company's stock. How much should I sell down?
skills.name: Single-stock concentration analysis

skills.description: Price a protective put, a zero-cost collar, and a put spread for a stock position at a given downside protection level and tenor.
examples: What would a protective put, a zero-cost collar, or a put spread on my 10,000 shares cost?
skills.name: Protective put, collar, and put spread pricing

skills.description: Check qualified small business stock (QSBS) eligibility and the resulting federal and state capital-gains exclusion.
examples: Do my shares qualify for the Section 1202 qualified small business stock exclusion?
skills.name: QSBS Section 1202 check

skills.description: Plan which equity lots to sell, and when, to fund a cash goal by a target date with the least after-tax cost.
examples: I need 200,000 dollars after tax for a down payment in 2 years. What should I sell and when?
skills.name: Fund a cash goal from equity
